@@ -57,7 +57,7 @@
     "needs_conversion": false,
     "raw_code": "(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find template row (row with most non-zero cells)
         (template-row
          (let loop ((r 0) (best-r 0) (best-cnt 0))
            (cond
              ((>= r h) best-r)
              (else
                (let ((cnt (length (filter (lambda (c) (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0)))
                                          (range 0 w)))))
                  (if (> cnt best-cnt)
                      (loop (+ r 1) r cnt)
                      (loop (+ r 1) best-r best-cnt)))))))
         (template (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (cell-at g template-row c))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (cond
          ((= r template-row) (cell-at g r c))
          (else
           ;; Check if this row has any non-zero cells
           (let ((row-cells (for/list ((cc (range 0 w))) (cell-at g r cc))))
             (cond
               ((for/and ((v row-cells)) (= v 0)) 0)  ;; empty row
               (else
                ;; Build color mapping from first few cells
                (let ((mapping (make-hash)))
                  (for ((cc (range 0 w)))
                    (when (not (= (cell-at g r cc) 0))
                      (hash-set! mapping (list-ref template cc) (cell-at g r cc))))
                  ;; Apply mapping to template
                  (hash-ref mapping (list-ref template c) 0))))))))))))",
     "solution_language": "racket",
